Strategy: Reward bins within one standard deviation of the mean residual, a wider typical-bin preference than the half-deviation test.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    v = sum([(x - m) ** 2 for x in bins]) / len(bins)
    s = sqrt(v)
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if abs(r - m) <= s else 0) for r in bins]
```
